question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**manage**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes emotional intelligence, which involves both understanding and handling emotions.
 
• The correct verb should indicate dealing with or handling emotions effectively.
 
• "**Manage**" fits well in the blank as it conveys the idea of regulating and handling emotions appropriately.
 
• Other options ("**amplify**", "**ignore**", "**overlook**") do not align with the context of emotional intelligence, which requires understanding and handling emotions rather than exaggerating or ignoring them.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amplify (बढ़ाना): "Amplify" means to increase or intensify, which does not fit the idea of handling emotions.
 
• Ignore (अनदेखा करना): "Ignore" means to disregard, which contradicts the purpose of emotional intelligence.
 
• Overlook (ध्यान न देना): "Overlook" means to miss or fail to notice, which is opposite to the idea of understanding and handling emotions effectively.
